# Metcalf.Solutions

> Portfolio and consulting site for Matthew Metcalf — Digital Strategist, Marketing Analyst, Web Infrastructure Specialist, and creator of Satori. Based in Central Arkansas.

## Primary Pages
- [Home & Portfolio](https://metcalf.solutions/): Digital strategy, campaign architecture, Cloudflare/managed hosting, and AI workflow automation.
- [Satori — Free, Open-Source AI Wisdom Companion](https://metcalf.solutions/satori/): Flagship open-source AI wisdom companion (v6.6.0, Apache 2.0) helping people think more clearly through difficult decisions, recurring patterns, and quiet burnout — combining 18 contemplative and psychological traditions across Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Gemini, and 10 CLI/IDE coding harnesses with a 100% local SQLite memory vault (`~/.satori/memory/`).
